but some BINS also allow us to know that the PAN is complete, in which case we can shift focus to the date field

Only set for a stored card,
brand is never set for a generic card component OR a single-branded card

properties.name: brands

properties.jsDoc:

01: [250px, 400px]
02: [390px, 400px]
03: [500px, 600px]
04: [600px, 400px]

- merchant set config option

properties.name: _disableClickToPay
properties.jsDoc: Disable Click to Pay for testing purposes

properties.name: disableIOSArrowKeys
properties.jsDoc: Turn on the procedure to force the arrow keys on an iOS soft keyboard to always be disabled

properties.name: disclaimerMessage
properties.jsDoc:

- merchant set config option

properties.name: doBinLookup
properties.jsDoc: Allow binLookup process to occur

properties.name: enableStoreDetails
properties.jsDoc:

- merchant set config option

properties.name: expiryMonth
properties.jsDoc: Comes from Stored payment method object

properties.name: exposeExpiryDate
properties.jsDoc:
Allows SF to return an unencrypted expiryDate
- merchant set config option

properties.name: forceCompat
properties.jsDoc:
Force securedFields to use the 'compat' version of JWE. (Use case: running custom http:// test environment
- merchant set config option

properties.name: fundingSource
properties.jsDoc: Funding source field populated when 'splitCardFundingSources' is used

properties.name: hasCVC
properties.jsDoc:
Decides whether the CVC (Security Code) component will even be rendered.
 Always true except when hideCVC set to false by merchant OR in the case of a *stored* BCMC card.
 (For the Bancontact card comp this is set to true since dual-branding possibilities mean the BCMC card can now end up needing to show a CVC field)

properties.name: hasHolderName
properties.jsDoc:
Show/hide the card holder name field
- merchant set config option

properties.name: hideCVC
properties.jsDoc:
Show/hide the Security Code field
- merchant set config option

properties.name: holderNameRequired
properties.jsDoc:
Whether the card holder name field will be required
- merchant set config option

properties.name: id
properties.jsDoc: Relates to storedCards

properties.name: installmentOptions
properties.jsDoc:
Configure the installment options for the card
- merchant set config option

properties.name: keypadFix
properties.jsDoc: Implements a workaround for iOS/Safari bug where keypad doesn't retract when SF paymentMethod is no longer active

properties.name: lastFour
properties.jsDoc: Related to storedCards - this information comes from the storedCardData once we process it

properties.name: legacyInputMode
properties.jsDoc: For some scenarios make the card input fields (PAN, Expiry Date, Security Code) have type="tel" rather than type="text" inputmode="numeric"

properties.name: maskSecurityCode
properties.jsDoc: Adds type="password" to the Security code input field, causing its value to be masked

properties.name: minimumExpiryDate
properties.jsDoc:
Specify the minimum expiry date that will be considered valid

- merchant set config option

properties.name: name
properties.jsDoc: When in Dropin this is the name shown in the paymentMethods list

properties.jsDoc:
Function used to perform 3rd party Address lookup

After binLookup call - provides the brand(s) we detect the user is entering, and if we support the brand(s)
- merchant set config option

properties.name: onBinValue
properties.jsDoc:
Provides the BIN Number of the card (up to 6 digits), called as the user types in the PAN.
- merchant set config option

properties.name: onBlur
properties.jsDoc:
Called when a field loses focus.
- merchant set config option

properties.name: onBrand

Called once we detect the card brand.
- merchant set config option

properties.name: onConfigSuccess
properties.jsDoc:
Called once the card input fields are ready to use.
- merchant set config option

properties.name: onAllValid
properties.jsDoc:
Called when *all* the securedFields becomes valid
 Also called again if one of the fields moves out of validity.

properties.name: onFieldValid
properties.jsDoc:
Called when a field becomes valid and also if a valid field changes and becomes invalid.
For the card number field, it returns the last 4 digits of the card number.
- merchant set config option

properties.name: onFocus
properties.jsDoc:
Called when a field gains focus.
- merchant set config option

properties.name: onLoad
properties.jsDoc:
Called once all the card input fields have been created but are not yet ready to use.
- merchant set config option

properties.name: placeholders
properties.jsDoc:
Configure placeholder text for holderName, cardNumber, expirationDate, securityCode and password.
- merchant set config option

properties.name: positionHolderNameOnTop
properties.jsDoc: Position holder name above card number field (instead of having it after the security code field)

properties.name: showBrandIcon

properties.jsDoc: Show/hide the contextual text under each form field. The contextual text is to assist shoppers filling in the payment form.

type will always be "card" (generic card, stored card)
